description: Add Convex backend infrastructure for danger-level notifications: schema tables (users, favoriteStations, notificationLog), notifications action, favorites query, and waterLevelUpdater trigger.
steps: Step 1: Update convex/schema.ts to add three new tables: (a) 'users' table with fields: externalId (v.string()), email (v.optional(v.string())), name (v.optional(v.string())), with index 'by_external_id' on ['externalId']. (b) 'favoriteStations' table with fields: userId (v.id('users')), stationId (v.id('stations')), with indexes 'by_user' on ['userId'], 'by_user_station' on ['userId', 'stationId'], and 'by_station' on ['stationId']. (c) 'notificationLog' table with fields: userId (v.id('users')), stationId (v.id('stations')), notifiedAt (v.number()), alertLevel (v.number()), with indexes 'by_user_station' on ['userId', 'stationId'] and 'by_notified_at' on ['notifiedAt'].

Step 2: Create convex/favorites.ts with an internalQuery named 'getUsersWhoFavoritedStation' that takes args { stationId: v.id('stations') }, queries the 'favoriteStations' table using the 'by_station' index filtered by stationId, collects the results, and returns an array of userId values (Id<'users'>[]).

Step 3: Create convex/notifications.ts with an internalAction named 'notifyDangerForStation' that takes args { stationId: v.id('stations'), currentLevel: v.number(), updatedAt: v.optional(v.string()) }. Implementation: (a) Use ctx.runQuery to call internal.favorites.getUsersWhoFavoritedStation to get userIds. (b) If no users, return early. (c) Look up station info via ctx.runQuery on a helper internalQuery (add 'getStationInfo' internalQuery to the same file or use an inline query). (d) For each userId, check notificationLog for a record within the last 1 hour (3600000 ms) using an internalQuery that checks the 'by_user_station' index for the (userId, stationId) pair and filters by notifiedAt > Date.now() - 3600000. (e) If not on cooldown, send push notification via OneSignal REST API: POST https://api.onesignal.com/notifications with headers { Authorization: 'Key ' + process.env.ONESIGNAL_REST_API_KEY, Content-Type: 'application/json' } and body { app_id: process.env.ONESIGNAL_APP_ID, included_segments: ['Subscribed Users'], headings: { en: 'Danger Level Alert' }, contents: { en: `Station ${stationName} has reached danger level (${currentLevel}m)` }, url: process.env.SITE_URL + '/stations/' + stationId }. Note: Since there's no per-user targeting without auth, use 'included_segments' to broadcast to all subscribed users. (f) After sending, record in notificationLog via ctx.runMutation on an internalMutation that inserts { userId, stationId, notifiedAt: Date.now(), alertLevel: 3 }. Add helper internalQuery 'getRecentNotification' and internalMutation 'recordNotification' in the same file.

Step 4: Update convex/sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts - modify the 'upsertCurrentLevel' internalMutation to detect rising transition into danger. Before updating the existing record, check if the previous alertLevel was < 3 and the new alertLevel is 3. If so, after the DB update, schedule the notification action. Since upsertCurrentLevel is a mutation (cannot call actions directly), use ctx.scheduler.runAfter(0, internal.notifications.notifyDangerForStation, { stationId, currentLevel, updatedAt }). Add the import for 'internal' from '../_generated/api' if not already present.

Step 5: Ensure the imports in the new files use the correct Convex patterns. notifications.ts should import { internalAction, internalQuery, internalMutation } from './_generated/server' and { internal } from './_generated/api' and { v } from 'convex/values'. favorites.ts should import { internalQuery } from './_generated/server' and { v } from 'convex/values'.
acceptance_criteria: convex/schema.ts contains users, favoriteStations, and notificationLog tables with all specified fields and indexes
convex/favorites.ts exports an internalQuery named getUsersWhoFavoritedStation
convex/notifications.ts exports an internalAction named notifyDangerForStation with OneSignal REST API integration
convex/notifications.ts includes helper internalQuery getRecentNotification and internalMutation recordNotification
convex/sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts detects alertLevel rising to 3 and schedules notifyDangerForStation via ctx.scheduler.runAfter
All files use proper Convex imports and TypeScript types
verification: Run TypeScript compilation on the convex directory: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/water-level && npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json
Verify new files exist and have correct exports by grepping for function names
findings: TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json) passes cleanly with zero errors. Vite build also passes. The _generated/api.d.ts references were not an issue since convex/tsconfig.json excludes _generated.
